# Varekai

> Varekai builds AI automation systems for small local businesses in Weatherford, Fort Worth
> and the wider Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex — AI voice agents that answer every call, instant
> missed-call text-back, automated follow-up, websites, local SEO, and process automation.

Varekai is a small AI automation consultancy based in Weatherford, Texas (Parker County),
serving home service companies, contractors, clinics, and other local service businesses
across Weatherford, Fort Worth, Aledo, Willow Park, Hudson Oaks, Springtown, Azle, Granbury,
Mineral Wells, Benbrook and the surrounding DFW area.

Contact: automate@varekai.ai · (817) 821-1316
Every engagement starts with a free assessment.

## Services — Get found

- [Website Design & Build](https://www.varekai.ai/website-design-build): Fast, mobile-first websites built to convert local searches into booked jobs.
- [SEO & AI Search Optimization](https://www.varekai.ai/seo-and-ai-search): Local SEO, Google Business Profile, and visibility inside AI answer engines.
- [Reviews & Referrals](https://www.varekai.ai/reviews-and-referrals): Automated review requests and referral flows that build local reputation.
- [Paid Social & Lead Ads](https://www.varekai.ai/paid-social-and-lead-ads): Facebook and Instagram lead ads wired to sub-minute follow-up.

## Services — Follow up fast

- [Missed-Call Text-Back](https://www.varekai.ai/missed-call-text-back): Any unanswered call gets an automatic text within seconds, so the caller does not go to a competitor.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.varekai.ai/ai-voice-agents): An AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7, qualifies the caller, and books the job.
- [Unsold Estimate Follow-Up](https://www.varekai.ai/unsold-estimate-follow-up): Automated follow-up on quotes that were never accepted or declined.
- [Database Reactivation](https://www.varekai.ai/database-reactivation): Campaigns that bring past customers back from your existing contact list.

## Services — Automate the rest

- [Process Automation](https://www.varekai.ai/process-automation): Removes the repetitive admin work — intake, scheduling, reminders, internal handoffs.
- [AI Agents](https://www.varekai.ai/ai-agents): Custom AI agents trained on your pricing, policies and service area, across chat, SMS and social.
- [Text-to-Pay & Invoicing](https://www.varekai.ai/text-to-pay-invoicing): Payment links by text, automatic reminders, and hands-off reconciliation.
- [Hiring & Recruiting](https://www.varekai.ai/hiring-and-recruiting): Automated screening, self-scheduled interviews and candidate follow-up.
